headline: Feyn AI Releases SQRL, a Text-to-SQL Model Family That Inspects the Database Before Writing a Query

sources.summary: Feyn Labs has released SQRL, a family of text-to-SQL models that inspect a database with read-only probes before committing to a query. The flagship SQRL-35B-A3B reports 70.6% execution accuracy on BIRD Dev, edging Claude Opus 4.6, and distills into self-hostable 4B and 9B checkpoints. The post Feyn AI Releases SQRL, a Text-to-SQL Model Family That Inspects the Database Before Writing a Query appeared first on MarkTechPost .
